purpose: P04 original-answer SFT/data/evaluation preparation; no teacher or KD

prompt_protocol.cot_suffix: If you are uncertain or the problem is too complex, make a reasoned guess based on the information provided. Avoid repeating steps indefinitely—provide your best guess even if unsure. Determine whether to think step by step based on the difficulty of the question, considering all relevant information before answering.

image_order: original image_N ascending, all images before text; preserve saved message content

scoring.repetition_abort: policy incorrect, extraction not attempted; raw answer availability separate
scoring.length_limit: retain any extractable answer, never automatically incorrect
scoring.open: exact Fraction and unit-preserving text/alias normalization; no tolerance or unit conversion
scoring.mc: GT-blind explicit-final/terminal answer, letter+body requires exact option agreement
